title: celtis sinensis f. rotundata
intro: Celtis sinensis f. rotundata, commonly known as the Chinese hackberry, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to China. It is valued for its leaves, which have been used in traditional Chinese medicine for their health benefits, including reducing fever, relieving headaches, and treating respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Celtis sinensis f. rotundata include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
